title: Photolabile oligonucleotides with topological light gradients enable spatially resolved single-cell transcriptomics and epigenomics - Nature Biotechnology
gist: UCSB researchers (Dey and Wilson labs) present scSTAMP-seq, which uses membrane-anchored photocleavable hashtag oligos and patterned light to 'stamp' spatial coordinates onto cells before standard plate- or droplet-based (10x Genomics) single-cell sequencing, extending to joint mRNA, chromatin accessibility and DNA methylation readout; demonstrated on 2D human gastruloids. The captured text is a subscription preview (abstract plus extended-data legends), so the insights come mainly from figure-legend data, although the raw record marks it as not paywalled.

insights.claim: scSTAMP-seq adds spatial information to standard single-cell sequencing by labeling cells with cholesterol-conjugated photocleavable hashtag oligonucleotides (PHOs) and then using patterned light to encode position before dissociation, so no specialized spatial array or in situ imaging readout is needed.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: A reagent-plus-optics add-on that runs on installed single-cell platforms could compete with dedicated spatial-array instruments on cost and adoption. Watch whether it is licensed or commercialized.
insights.quote: a modular light-encoded barcoding strategy that preserves spatial information while leveraging standard single-cell platforms

insights.claim: Light-induced PHO cleavage is continuous rather than binary: the Cy5-to-Cy3 fluorescence ratio tracks DLP light intensity, and a non-linear radial light gradient was designed to produce linear photocleavage across a colony, maximizing the dynamic range of the positional readout.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Analog gradients mean one illumination round can encode a continuous coordinate, which reduces barcode count and cost per spatial resolution unit.
insights.quote: A non-linear light decay profile was selected for the illumination pattern to produce linear photocleavage of PHOs across radial position

insights.claim: Digital micromirror device (DMD) photomasks can label individual user-selected cells. In a HeLa/U2OS co-culture, masks thresholded on mCherry-positive HeLa cells selectively cleaved PHOs on those cells (79 HeLa vs 552 U2OS cells, p < 2.22e-16).
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Image-guided selection of cells to sequence enables phenotype-to-transcriptome linking, a use case beyond spatial mapping with potential screening applications.

insights.claim: Sequential rounds of optical labeling with distinct PHOs increase spatial resolution, and bridging oligonucleotides (PHO-v2 + BO) preserve earlier labeling rounds so that spatial encoding capacity grows exponentially with the number of rounds (shown with 2x4 and 3x6 schemes).
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Combinatorial scaling is the path from coarse regional labels toward high-resolution mapping. Resolution claims in later versions will hinge on this.
insights.quote: illustrating how BO-mediated preservation of previous labeling patterns enables exponential expansion of spatial encoding capacity

insights.claim: Multiplexing six PHOs (PHO1-6) with different illumination durations (0 to 18 s) across 195 cells enables error correction and improves the spatial resolution of scSTAMP-seq.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Redundant barcodes address noise in single-cell spatial calls, which is a key robustness question for any method used outside the lab.

insights.claim: UV illumination at saturating doses does not perturb the endogenous transcriptome. Illuminated and non-illuminated cells correlate at Pearson r = 0.997 (plate-based, 14,983 genes) and r = 0.992 (droplet-based 10x, 28,073 genes).
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: This removes the main biological objection to light-based labeling (UV damage artifacts) and supports adoption.

insights.claim: scSTAMP-seq runs on droplet-based 10x Genomics Chromium workflows as well as plate-based CEL-Seq-style workflows. PHO-derived molecules are separated from endogenous cDNA by SPRI bead size selection and amplified into separate Illumina libraries.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Compatibility with the dominant 10x installed base expands addressable use and pulls through 10x consumables and Illumina sequencing, rather than displacing them.

insights.claim: PHOs on live-cell membranes have an estimated half-life of 9.05 hours, which sets the time window for live-cell scSTAMP-seq experiments. A biotin-streptavidin anchoring alternative to cholesterol anchoring is also shown.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Workflow constraint: labeling-to-dissociation must fit within hours, which limits long live-imaging protocols.
insights.quote: The measured decay corresponds to an estimated half-life of PHOs on cell membranes to be 9.05 hours

insights.claim: The method works on DSP-fixed as well as live cells. Transcriptomes of fixed and live cells correlate at Pearson r = 0.967 across 15,895 genes, and photocleavage occurs in both states.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Fixed-sample compatibility matters for clinical and biobank samples, where live processing is impractical.

insights.claim: scSTAMP-MAT-seq jointly profiles spatial position, mRNA, chromatin accessibility (GpC methylation by M.CviPI) and endogenous CpG DNA methylation from the same cell, with performance close to non-spatial scMAT-seq: a median of 96,000 vs 109,000 accessible GpC sites and 55,000 vs 59,000 methylated CpG sites per cell.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Adding space costs roughly 5-12% of epigenomic sensitivity, a modest penalty that makes spatial epigenomics on standard workflows plausible, a segment few spatial platforms address.

insights.claim: Applied to 2D gastruloids derived from human iPSCs, scSTAMP-seq resolved radial expression profiles of lineage markers (CDX2, SOX17, EOMES, DNMT3B), grouped genes into four spatial expression patterns, and mapped the spatial distribution of chromatin regulators, including Polycomb group proteins.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Demonstration is in developmental biology and organoid models, so near-term demand is academic research and stem-cell or organoid tools rather than clinical use.
insights.quote: showing how spatial organization and epigenetic states coregulate cellular programs in heterogeneous biological systems

insights.claim: Four authors (Piscopio, Chialastri, Wilson and Dey of UC Santa Barbara) are inventors on a patent application covering scSTAMP-seq, and the analysis code is open on GitHub (deylabucsb/scSTAMP-seq).
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Patent-pending academic IP is a candidate for licensing to single-cell or spatial tool vendors or for a spinout. Monitor UCSB tech-transfer activity.
insights.quote: R.A.P., A.C., M.Z.W. and S.S.D. are inventors on a patent application for this method.

insights.claim: The paper took more than three years from submission (16 August 2023) to acceptance (1 September 2026), which suggests the method is not new and competing light-directed barcoding approaches (such as Light-Seq and ZipSeq) have developed in parallel.
insights.speaker: Nature Biotechnology
insights.so_what: Crowded prior art in optical barcoding may weaken patent exclusivity. Weigh this before assigning commercial moat value.
